title: Senior Data & AI Engineer - Databricks - London - £90K
description:
Senior Data & AI Engineer - Databricks - London - £90K


I'm currently looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join a growing organisation that is investing heavily in its data and AI capabilities. This is an opportunity to work with modern cloud technologies, influence technical direction, and deliver solutions that drive real business value.

You'll play a key role in designing and building scalable data platforms, enabling data-driven decision-making and supporting the adoption of AI across the organisation. Working closely with stakeholders across the business, you'll help transform complex data challenges into innovative, impactful solutions.

Key Skills & Experience

  • Extensive experience with Databricks
  • Strong SQL and data modelling expertise
  • Solid understanding of data warehousing and ETL processes
  • Experience with cloud-based data platforms and modern data architectures
  • Exposure to AI and machine learning technologies
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills

Why Join?

  • Work on high-impact data and AI initiatives
  • Join a collaborative, technology-focused team
  • Opportunity to shape and influence a growing data function
  • Supportive environment with strong career development opportunities
  • Flexible hybrid working model in London

Please reach out asap for more information.

You must be based in the UK and sponsorship is not provided for this role.
